note: This file is a pure MMDetection configuration file containing only dictionary literals and variable assignments. It has no functions, classes, or callable APIs. It inherits from fcos_r50-caffe_fpn_gn-head_1x_coco.py and overrides the backbone to ResNeXt-101 (64x4d), enables multi-scale training at 640-800px, and sets a 24-epoch (2x) training schedule with MultiStepLR.
summarize_config: summarize the FCOS ResNeXt-101 64x4d FPN GN-head multi-scale 2x COCO detection config
review_backbone: review the ResNeXt-101 64x4d backbone settings with pretrained open-mmlab weights
review_train_pipeline: review the multi-scale training pipeline with RandomChoiceResize at 640 and 800 pixel scales
review_param_scheduler: review the learning rate schedule with ConstantLR warmup and MultiStepLR milestones at epochs 16 and 22
review_model_preprocessor: review the DetDataPreprocessor with BGR to RGB conversion and ImageNet normalization values
